columns:
Mr. Faling joined the Board in February 2015 as an independent
and non-executive Director. Mr. Faling has worked extensively
in the electricity sector since 1972. As Executive Director of
Transmission, Mr. Faling was a member of Eskom’s Management
Board from 1993 to 1999 and also played a key role in the
restructuring of Eskom’s generation business. For the past 16
years, Mr. Faling has acted in advisory and management capacity
to multiple energy projects in South Africa, Kosovo, Nigeria and
Mozambique.
